title: Tunisian column inscription of the Canaanites who fled Joshua

tellings.quote: there was a column that had a an inscription and the inscription read, "We are the Canaanites who fled before the face of Joshua the son of Nun."

plain: A column in Tunisia once carried an inscription reading "We are the Canaanites who fled before the face of Joshua the son of Nun", according to a researcher of giants and ancient mysteries named Tim Alberino. He tells Michels this without naming where he read it, and if true it would be a trace, far from Canaan, of the people the Bible says Joshua drove out.
